label: Korbáčik
note: Smoked and unsmoked, also salty or garlic versions.

about.text: Korbáčik, Polish korbacz, is a semi-hard string cheese from the Orava region of Slovakia and southern Poland: steamed cheese pulled into fine threads and interwoven into braids. It comes smoked or unsmoked, from sheep or cow milk.
